title: ArdaMaps
description: A mapping mod for the Ardacraft server. Adds an interactive map, compass and toposcope HUDs, fog-of-war exploration tracking, and an in-game guide book.
body:
# ArdaMaps
![Minecraft 1.20.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-62b47a?style=flat-square)
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-loader-dbb66e?style=flat-square)
[![License: CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC%20BY%204.0-lightgrey?style=flat-square)](LICENSE.txt)

## Features

- Interactive map with support for PMTiles, [BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap) tiles, and flat images.
- Map layer support and configurable zoom levels
- Compass and Toposcope HUDs showing nearby landmarks with distance
- Fog-of-war exploration tracking
- In-game guide book, fully customizable via resource pack

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- [ArdaRegions](https://modrinth.com/mod/ardaregions) should be setup and running on the server
- A valid map source: PMTiles, [BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap) or flat image

## Setup

### 1. Install on Server

1. Install the mod jar on the **server's** `/mods/` directory
2. Start the server once - `config/arda-maps/server.json` is created automatically
3. Edit `server.json`: set your API URLs and define at least one dimension entry

### 2. Install on Client

1. Install the mod jar on the **client's** `/mods/` directory
2. Client configuration is auto-generated on each player's first login.
